fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 55% match makes this a Fair Fit for the Senior Customer Enablement Manager role at Figma.

**Strengths:**
- Wrote the Year 9 practical curriculum and trained 12 colleagues
- Workshop facilitation and one-to-one coaching, live training delivery
- Track progress in spreadsheets and present results to senior leadership

**Gaps:**
- No 4+ years in customer success, account management, or SaaS
- No renewal risk mitigation or strategic account portfolio experience
- No Figma use or UX/UI, design ops, or frontend background

**Recommendation:** Apply with a cover letter that frames your curriculum design, colleague training, and data reporting as enablement work, and first pursue a junior customer enablement or customer success role at a SaaS company to build the required experience.

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your ad asks for someone who can help large customers get real value from the platform, which means turning complex features into things people actually use. That is the problem I've worked on for 8 years in the classroom. I wrote my department's Year 9 practical curriculum and trained 12 colleagues to use it, so rolling out something new to adults who have their own habits and priorities is familiar to me.

I'm a physics teacher and Head of Year 9 at Ashgrove Academy, and the work maps closely to your role. I deliver workshops and one-to-one coaching, track progress in spreadsheets and present results to senior leadership each term, which is the same habit as using product data to inform proactive engagement strategies. I hold weekly parent calls and run parents' evenings, so building trusted relationships with stakeholders from individual contributors to senior leaders is routine for me. I haven't worked in SaaS or used Figma professionally, so I'm offering a different route: clear communication, curriculum design and a data-minded approach, backed by Excel, basic Python and the Google Data Analytics Certificate, which I'm completing now. Your "Grow as you go" value describes how I work.

I'd welcome a conversation about how I could help your London team design and deliver enablement plans that drive adoption. I'm available to talk at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor

applicationEmail.body:
Hello Figma Hiring Team,

After 8 years of teaching physics, I know how to explain complex things clearly and help a whole group adopt something new, which is the heart of customer enablement. I wrote my department's Year 9 practical curriculum, trained colleagues to use it, and present progress data to senior leadership each term. My CV and cover letter are attached with the full detail. I'm available for a call on any weekday afternoon.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor
